items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: And Buddy Tate was there at the same time, and Bud and I could not run across

ctx.x: from Paris and went to Jutland

Copenhagen because he came in (unintelligible), which is down on the other side, which is part of Copenhagen, in Denmark anyway. And Buddy Tate was there at the same time, and Bud and I could not run across (unintelligible) because when I was in Sweden Bud was back in Copenhagen. And then the promoter's girlfriend and his mother were born in Jutland (unintelligible). So when she came back one time for the weekend and her girlfriend and some of her relatives, (unintelligible) says, well, we saw Benny Waters…

And he was in Jutland, so he sent word for me to come out there, but I was almost on the closing end of this concert thing, and we were going to Norway, and we went to Sweden and back there and we back there for some taping.
